messages:
incident-bot: Alert: postmortem 'ingest-backpressure' action item #5 (owner: @carla) is 9 days overdue. Please update status or reassign. Tracker: https://redwood.company/pm/ingest-backpressure/actions :mag:
carla: Sorry everyone, slipped when sprint priorities shifted. I'm blocked by a flaky integration test that fails under the stress harness. Have a WIP fix for backpressure token bucket but need to validate it against multi-region load.
ben: Can you paste the failing test output? We need to decide if we should gate the schema migration scheduled for Friday.
carla: Test log snippet:
```
2026-03-12T17:44:02Z WARN ingress.go:201 enqueue latency spike: 980ms
2026-03-12T17:44:03Z ERROR throttle.go:89 tokenbucket: underflow detected: -3
```
ben: That's consistent with the influx we saw during the Canary last month. If fix doesn't land, we should freeze the migration.
ops-oncall: @carla do you need an infra window to run the multi-region harness? We have 02:00-04:00 UTC available.
carla: Yes please. Also need @infra-sre to STS a test cluster with identical autoscale settings.
leo_pm: This blocks the analytics ingest pipeline upgrade; if not done by Friday we'll notify partners. Please update tracker with contingency.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow up with @carla in 48h.
infra-sre: I can provision a cluster tonight 23:00 UTC. Carla, ping when you have the DAG to run and I'll handover credentials.
(Next day)
carla: Dry-run executed against test cluster. Found race in token refill under bursty loads. Instrumentation attached to tracker.
ben: Good find. Do you have a mitigation we can patch quickly?
carla: Short-term: add a guard that rejects excess bursts with 429 and buffers upstream for 2s. Long-term: make token refill atomic and reduce shard contention. Short-term PR: https://git.redwood/ingest/pulls/1290
ops-oncall: If you implement the 429 guard, we should update customer-facing rate-limits doc and add a temporary banner to Console during rollout.
carla: Will add the banner and doc note. ETA EOD tomorrow for short-term rollout.
incident-bot: Reminder: follow up in 24h with @carla.
(24h later)
carla: Short-term PR merged, canaryed at 5% -> 25% traffic. Observed reduced enqueue latency and no underflow errors. Canary metrics: enqueue p95 820ms -> 210ms.
ben: Nice. Can you paste the canary traces and open an action to implement the atomic refill? This must be part of closure criteria.
carla: Created action #12 for the atomic refill, assigned to @carla with ETA +7 days. Updated postmortem closure checklist.
leo_pm: Given recurrence across three incidents, please tag as 'recurring' and include in the monthly reliability review.
ops-oncall: We'll keep the migration window but gate the schema rollout until the atomic refill is merged or we have a validated fallback.
incident-bot: Action #5 moved to status 'verifying' in tracker. Reminder set for 7 days.
(6 days later)
carla: Quick update: atomic refill PR ready for review: https://git.redwood/ingest/pulls/1304. Running stress tests now.
infra-sre: Reviewed and left comments. One nit around metric cardinality.
ben: I'll help with review this afternoon. If review stalls, ping me and I'll take it.
(Next day)
carla: PR merged, canaryed and promoted to 100% with no regressions. Added prometheus alert: ingest_token_orphan_count > 5 for 5m.
ops-oncall: Verified no alerts during promotion.
incident-bot: Action #5 marked 'done' by @carla in tracker.
leo_pm: Closing the action in postmortem. Adding note: set periodic audits for token bucket health (monthly). Scheduling for reliability review.
carla: Added final remediation notes and links to patches. Thanks for the nudges and pairing help. :handshake:
